name_en: Eleven FFmpeg grade presets
what: جدول GRADES في montage.py: أحد عشر تلوينًا مسمّى (curves/colorbalance/eq) تطبّقه على مقطع أو على كل لقطة في المونتاج، والحبيبات مبذورة فتتكرر النتيجة نفسها. / The montage.py GRADES table: eleven named curves/colorbalance/eq grades for one clip or per cut, with seeded grain so re-renders are identical.
how: CLI: `python montage.py grade CLIP.mp4 --preset teal_orange [--out X.mp4]` (also `kmotion grade`, `montage cut --grade`, timeline JSON `clips[].grade`, `smart_montage.py grade`). Output libx264 -preset medium -crf 17, format=yuv420p, audio stream copied untouched. The same chain can be pasted into any `-vf`. Verified in this container on 2026-10-16: all 11 chains ran on testsrc2 with rc=0 (blue_hour pulls YAVG 121.6→108.2 and V 127→133.7; teal_orange pushes U to 135.6), and kosif-studio's test asserts blue_hour + sodium_night run through ffmpeg. The kosif-studio, 100-superskills and kosif-one/tools tables match value for value (only line endings differ); kosif-omni's smart_montage carries the first six at CRF 18 with unseeded vintage grain alls=12 — prefer the seeded table. (code snippet in references/powers/color-palette-grading.md) (full table in references/powers/color-palette-grading.md)
params: 11 presets; CRF 17 (smart_montage CRF 18); grain all_seed=7; audio -c:a copy

name_en: Restore grade for old or soft footage
what: تلوين إنقاذ: إزالة ضوضاء زمنية خفيفة، سواد أنظف، انضغاط للإضاءات، دفء خفيف في المنتصف، وشحذ متكيف — ونسخة FINAL_EDIT المضبوطة يدويًا التي شُحنت. / A rescue grade: light temporal denoise, cleaner blacks, highlight roll-off, warmer mids and contrast-adaptive sharpening — plus the hand-tuned FINAL_EDIT variant that shipped.
how: `montage.py grade CLIP --preset restore`. Chain: hqdn3d=1.2:1.2:3:3 → eq contrast 1.12 brightness −0.015 saturation 1.07 gamma 0.97 → curves all `0/0 .06/.035 .25/.22 .5/.5 .8/.82 .94/.93 1/.97` → colorbalance rs .012 bs −.01 rm .025 gm .005 bm −.02 → cas 0.3. FINAL_EDIT (talking head, Lanczos 720×1280→1080×1920): eq contrast 1.12 brightness −0.02 saturation 1.10 gamma 0.96, same curves, colorbalance rs .015 bs −.01 rm .01, cas 0.32. Ran here on testsrc2 (rc=0). Upscale before CAS, never after.
params: hqdn3d 1.2:1.2:3:3; gamma .97/.96; cas .3/.32; whites capped at .97

name_en: One-line project grades (muted Ghorba, navy door + RTL mirror)
what: تلوينات صغيرة شُحنت في مشاريع حقيقية: «الغربة» الهادئ المعتم قليلًا بنسختين، وتلوين colorbalance يسحب لقطة رمادية نحو الكحلي مع عكس أفقي ليفرغ اليمين للنص العربي. / Small grades shipped in real projects: the quiet, slightly darker Ghorba look in two calibrations, and a colorbalance pull from charcoal toward brand navy with an hflip so empty space sits on the right for Arabic text.
how: Ghorba v1 `eq=contrast=1.08:saturation=0.86:brightness=-0.023`, v2 `eq=contrast=1.06:saturation=0.95:brightness=-0.009` inside the per-shot -vf. Navy door: `-vf "hflip,colorbalance=rs=-.10:gs=-.03:bs=.25:rm=-.05:bm=.10"` then H.264 width 1280 crf 27 -an +faststart. All three ran here on testsrc2 (rc=0).

name_en: Bake any grade into a Hald CLUT / .cube and apply LUTs
what: تحوّل أي سلسلة FFmpeg إلى صورة Hald أو ملف .cube بحجم 33 نقطة، ثم تطبقها بـlut3d أو haldclut بنتيجة شبه مطابقة — وتطبق LUT التحويل أو LUT الإبداعي من الكاميرا بالطريقة نفسها. / Turn any FFmpeg chain into a Hald image or a 33-point .cube and re-apply it with lut3d/haldclut almost identically; camera conversion and creative LUTs go in the same way.
how: haldclutsrc=8 (64³ entries) → run the grade chain on that one frame → apply with `[v][hald]haldclut=interp=tetrahedral`, or resample the Hald to a 33³ .cube (NumPy, R fastest) and use `lut3d=file=look.cube:interp=tetrahedral`. Verified here with teal_orange on 640×360 testsrc2: Hald vs direct grade PSNR 51.9 dB, 33³ cube vs direct 47.9 dB. Spatial or temporal parts (noise, unsharp, cas, vignette) do not bake — re-add them after the LUT. Use 33- or 65-point cubes and tetrahedral interpolation on 10-bit sources to avoid banding; never apply a conversion LUT twice. (code snippet in references/powers/color-palette-grading.md)
params: haldclutsrc level 8; cube 33³ (or 65³); PSNR 51.9 / 47.9 dB measured

name_en: Browser looks: CSS filter + blend-mode tint layers
what: أحد عشر لوكًا من محرر «بصمة» تُبنى من فلتر CSS واحد وطبقات صبغة بأنماط دمج، مع منزلقات تباين وتشبع وإضاءة، وتلوين «الحبر والزعفران» الذي يعيد تلوين فيديو بلا إعادة ترميز. / Basma's eleven looks built from one CSS filter plus blended tint layers, with contrast/saturation/brightness sliders, and the 'ink & saffron' re-tone that recolours a clip at runtime without re-encoding.
how: Canvas: ctx.filter = look.f, drawImage, then for each tint [hex, alpha, mode] set globalAlpha + globalCompositeOperation and fillRect; then gradeFilter adds contrast() saturate() brightness() from sliders (contrast 0.8–1.4, saturate 0.5–1.6, brightness 0.8–1.2, vignette 0–0.8, optional soft-light tint alpha 0.16). Ink & saffron (video element): grayscale(1) sepia(.5) saturate(1.35) hue-rotate(-8deg) contrast(1.05) brightness(.82); banner wash linear-gradient(160deg, rgba(217,83,14,.55), rgba(29,24,20,.9)) with background-blend-mode:color. All 12 rendered in Chromium (Playwright) in this container on 2026-10-16. (code snippet in references/powers/color-palette-grading.md) (full table in references/powers/color-palette-grading.md)
params: 11 looks + ink_saffron; slider ranges c .8–1.4 / s .5–1.6 / b .8–1.2

what: سكربت بايثون مُصدَّر من استوديو «بصمة» يعيد إنتاج التلوين بفلاتر FFmpeg عادية: eq وcolorbalance وفينيت وحبيبات وأشرطة سينما. / The Python script Basma exports reproduces a look with plain FFmpeg: eq, colorbalance, vignette, grain and letterbox bars.

what: محرك تلوين WebGL كامل: تعريض وتباين وإضاءات وظلال وأبيض وأسود وحرارة وصبغة وحيوية وتشبع، وعجلات وثلاثة منحنيات وحتى أربع تحديدات HSL وحبيبات وفينيت وLUT، مع 17 إعدادًا جاهزًا وأداة تحفظ المعالجة على العنصر. / A full WebGL grade: exposure/contrast/highlights/shadows/whites/blacks/temperature/tint/vibrance/saturation, wheels, curves, up to 4 HSL selections, grain, vignette, custom .cube, 17 presets, and a CLI that persists the treatment on an element.

Persist: `npx hyperframes media-treatment --selector '#hero' --grading '<json>' --apply --json`; measure with `--analyze --json`; list controls with `--capabilities --json`. name_en: Grade order: technical before creative
what: التصحيح التقني أولًا لكل لقطة ثم عقدة «لوك» إبداعية منفصلة؛ لا تخلطهما أبدًا. / Per-clip technical correction first, then a separate creative LOOK node; never mix the two.
how: Resolve: EXPOSURE → WB (before the Log→Rec.709 transform) → CST/LUT → CONTRAST → SAT (ceiling ~1.25 with shadow/highlight roll-off) → LOOK as a new serial node; LUT/CST runs first in time and everything is measured on its output. DWG/Intermediate path: input CST → global exposure → WB → contrast 1.3 pivot 0.336 → colour-slice sat → selective → output CST → creative LUT, tetrahedral. FFmpeg analogue: eq/exposure → colorbalance/colortemperature → lut3d → eq=contrast → hue=s → look LUT/curves, each its own filter. Phone footage needs less.

name_en: Log detection before a conversion LUT
what: لا تطبق LUT تحويل Log إلا على لقطة ثبت أنها Log؛ وسم bt709 والمظهر الباهت ليسا دليلًا. / Apply a Log→Rec.709 LUT only to clips proven Log; a bt709 tag or a flat look is not evidence.
how: Priority: user profile > NLE input colour space/gamma containing 'log' > `ffprobe -show_streams -of json` color_transfer containing 'log' > 8-bit yuv420p ⇒ not Log (Apple Log / I-Log are 10-bit). Some Log files are tagged bt709. Then `lut3d=Log_to_Rec709.cube` (65-point), once only. `--selftest` passed in this container on 2026-10-16 (PYTHONPATH = the exposure skill's scripts). Live CDL writes need DaVinci Resolve Studio (paid app, not here); in this container apply the same numbers with FFmpeg.
params: 10-bit required for Apple Log / I-Log; 65-point cube

name_en: Exposure bands by time of day + cut jump caps
what: لا تساوِ إضاءة كل اللقطات: الليل أغمق والساعة الذهبية الأسطع، وحدّ أقصى لقفزة الإضاءة بين لقطتين متتاليتين حتى لا تتعب العين. / Don't normalise everything: night darker, golden hour brightest, and cap the brightness jump between adjacent cuts to avoid flicker fatigue.
how: Measure median luma (10-bit 0–1023): night 120–280, morning 320–460, day 420–560, golden 440–600, blue hour 310–485. Adjacent tail→head difference ≤60 same period / ≤120 across periods; per-clip shift ≤±120; >0.5% pixels clipped lowers target by 40; tolerance 15; sunrise/sunset windows ±30 min / 1.5 h. FFmpeg: `signalstats` YAVG → `eq=brightness/gamma`. `--selftest` passed in this container on 2026-10-16 (PYTHONPATH = the exposure skill's scripts). Live CDL writes need DaVinci Resolve Studio (paid app, not here); in this container apply the same numbers with FFmpeg.

name_en: Neutral-pixel white balance
what: تقدير الصبغة من البكسلات الرمادية متوسطة الإضاءة، وتثبيت الأخضر وتحريك الأحمر والأزرق — مع خيار إبقاء دفء أو برودة مقصودة. / Estimate the cast from low-saturation mid-brightness pixels, hold G and move R/B, optionally keeping a deliberate warm or cool bias.
how: Downscale to 320 px; neutral = max channel 25–85% and saturation ≤20%; need ≥0.5% of pixels; target R−B = 0 (or +30 warm / −20 cool on request); CDL Offset ±0.10, Slope 1±0.20, ≤3 secant iterations. FFmpeg: colorbalance / colortemperature / colorchannelmixer, or `grayworld` (built in here). `--selftest` passed in this container on 2026-10-16 (PYTHONPATH = the exposure skill's scripts). Live CDL writes need DaVinci Resolve Studio (paid app, not here); in this container apply the same numbers with FFmpeg.

name_en: Pivot contrast with clip guard
what: تباين S حول نقطة ارتكاز تناسب فضاء العقدة، ويتراجع تلقائيًا إذا بدأ السواد أو البياض بالقص. / S-contrast around a pivot matched to the node space that backs off automatically if blacks or whites clip.
how: Default 1.15 (range 0.5–1.5), pivot 0.435 on the LUT path, 0.336 for DaVinci Intermediate; clipping if p1 < 16 or p99 > 1008 (10-bit) or >0.5% clipped → reduce, max 3 retries, stop at 1.0. FFmpeg: curves S or eq=contrast with a pivoted lutyuv. `--selftest` passed in this container on 2026-10-16 (PYTHONPATH = the exposure skill's scripts). Live CDL writes need DaVinci Resolve Studio (paid app, not here); in this container apply the same numbers with FFmpeg.

what: أضف تشبعًا فقط للقطات الباهتة عن نطاق وقتها (لا تنقص أبدًا)، بحد 1.25، واخفض التشبع في الظلال والإضاءات العالية كما يفعل الفيلم. / Only add saturation to clips below their time-of-day band (never remove), capped at 1.25, rolling saturation off in shadows and highlights like film.
how: Bands (mean max−min, 10-bit): morning 50–110, day 60–120, afternoon 60–130, evening 45–100, night 30–80; Sat = floor/measured ≤1.25; roll-off below 15% and above 85% luma down to 60%. FFmpeg: eq=saturation / hue=s plus a luma-selective lutyuv. `--selftest` passed in this container on 2026-10-16 (PYTHONPATH = the exposure skill's scripts). name_en: Scope-target looks (Japan summer, New York, Still, Tokyo night)
what: لوكات إبداعية مكتوبة كأهداف قياس على مخرج Rec.709: نسب IRE لـP10/P50/P95 ونصف قطر عناقيد اللون على الفكتورسكوب. / Creative looks written as measurable targets on the Rec.709 output: P10/P50/P95 in IRE and colour-cluster radius on a normalised vectorscope.
how: Y'=0.2126R'+0.7152G'+0.0722B', IRE=100·Y'; Cb=(B'−Y')/1.8556, Cr=(R'−Y')/1.5748; radius normalised to the 100% colour-bar hexagon. Build with curves/colorbalance/lut3d, compare +0/+1/+2 stop variants, then measure. (full table in references/powers/color-palette-grading.md)

name_ar: توجيه التلوين حسب اللقطة وأرضية الإضاءة
name_en: Per-shot-type direction, one light floor, value before colour
what: جدول تلوين لكل نوع لقطة، وأرضية إضاءة واحدة وسقف واحد للفيلم كله، والقيمة (الفاتح/الغامق) تُقرر قبل اللون. / A grade table per shot type, one luminance floor and ceiling per film, and value (light/dark) decided before hue.
how: Table shot type | colour direction | notes: talking head = base grade with warm ambient pull; screen recordings crisp, high-contrast on text; graphics on the brand background; animation free palette; drifting scenes get a correction note. Name one floor (deepest black) and the brightest section's ceiling — no jumps dark→white. Realistic tonal range > 150 of 255; peak saturation only in fire and eyes.
params: tonal range >150/255; one floor per film

name_en: Colour analysis: CCT, cast, colourfulness, 6-colour palette
what: أداة تقرأ صورة أو إطارًا وتعطيك: حرارة اللون بالكلفن، وميله الدافئ/البارد، ومقدار الألوان، وتوزيع الإضاءة، وستة ألوان سائدة بحصصها. / Reads an image or frame and returns CCT in kelvin, warm/cool cast, colourfulness, tonal zones and six dominant colours with shares.
how: `python3 kosif-one/tools/kosif-omni/skills/kosif-vision/scripts/image_analyze.py FRAME.png` → JSON: exposure (p1/median/p99, clipped %, zones, verdict), colour (McCamy CCT via sRGB→linear→XYZ, valid 1000–25000 K; cast warm if R̄−B̄ > 12, cool if < −12; colourfulness = hypot(σrg, σyb) + 0.3·hypot(μrg, μyb) labelled <15 not … >82 highly) and palette (median-cut to 6 on a 256 px thumbnail). Ran here on a graded frame.
params: cast ±12; CCT 1000–25000 K; palette k=6 @256 px

name_en: Mired shift → CTO/CTB gel
what: حساب حتمي: من حرارة إلى حرارة كم «ميرد» وأي جل يقرّبك — لتخطيط إضاءة لقطة أو برومبت أو مشهد ثلاثي الأبعاد مقنع. / Deterministic maths: mired shift between two colour temperatures and the nearest gel, for believable lighting in shots, prompts and 3D.
how: `echo '{"op":"mired","from_k":3200,"to_k":5600}' | python3 light_calc.py` → shift = 1e6/to − 1e6/from. Ran here: −133.9 → Full CTB, 'cooler (blue)'. Gels: Full CTB −159, ½ CTB −68, ¼ CTB −30, ⅛ CTB −12, ⅛ CTO +20, ¼ CTO +42, ½ CTO +81, Full CTO +159.

name_en: Basma measured auto-fix, reference match and look classifier
what: يصلح الفيديو المعتم أو المسطح أو المصبوغ من بكسلاته بلا ذكاء اصطناعي ويشرح الإصلاح بالعربية، ويطابق مقطعك مع مرجع، ويسمّي لوك المرجع. / Fixes dark/flat/cast footage from its own pixels without AI and explains the fix in Arabic, matches a clip to a reference, and labels the reference's look.
how: measureFix(): luma percentiles p02/p50/p98; contrast = clamp(200/range, 0.9, 1.3) when range < 200; brightness toward mid 118 (0.85–1.3) when mid outside 112–150; saturation clamp(0.24/s, 1, 1.25) when 0.05 < s < 0.18; grey-world on near-neutral pixels (s < 0.22, 50 < l < 215, ≥6% of pixels) → per-channel gains 0.82–1.18 as a multiply colour. Match: contrast ratio clamp 0.8–1.4, saturate 0.5–1.6, brightness 0.8–1.2, tint = reference mean hex, bw when ref saturation < 0.08, letterbox copied. DNA classifier: sat < 0.07 → bw; blue shadows > 6 with red highlights > 10 → teal_orange; warmth > 0.1 → golden (sat > 0.3) or warm; warmth < −0.05 → blue_hour (mean L < 90) or cool; contrast > 0.26 & sat > 0.32 → clean; sat > 0.45 & dark → cyber. Runs inside the Basma editor (Vite app).
install: cd /home/user/app && npm install && npm run dev

what: أوكابي-إيتو وبول تول ولوحة الفئات السبع بإضاءة متساوية — ومع كل لون شكل أو تسمية، لأن 8% من الرجال لا يميزون الأحمر من الأخضر. / Okabe-Ito, Paul Tol and a matched-lightness 7-hue set — always paired with shape or label, because ~8% of men miss red/green.
how: Okabe-Ito #E69F00 #56B4E9 #009E73 #F0E442 #0072B2 #D55E00 #CC79A7 #000000 (on white use #0072B2 #D55E00 #009E73 #CC79A7 #000000 for 3:1). Tol Bright #4477AA #EE6677 #228833 #CCBB44 #66CCEE #AA3377 #BBBBBB (7); High-contrast #004488 #DDAA33 #BB5566 (3, best in greyscale); Vibrant #EE7733 #0077BB #33BBEE #EE3377 #CC3311 #009988 #BBBBBB. 7-hue: hsl(220 70% 55%) (160 60% 45%) (40 90% 55%) (310 60% 55%) (10 70% 55%) (270 50% 55%) (85 50% 45%). Never interpolate these; ≤5–7 categories; add icons, direct labels, dashes; simulate with Chrome 'Emulate vision deficiencies'.

name_en: Colormap semantics and chart colour hierarchy
what: اختر نوع الخريطة اللونية حسب معنى البيانات، ولون تمييز واحد يحمل الاستنتاج والباقي رمادي، ولكل لون معنى واحد في الفيلم كله. / Pick the colormap by what the data means; one accent carries the insight, context stays grey; each hue has exactly one meaning per film.
how: Sequential = monotonic lightness (viridis, plasma, inferno, magma, cividis); diverging only around a meaningful centre (RdBu_r, PuOr, BrBG) with a centred norm (e.g. vmin −2, centre 0, vmax 5), no-data in neutral grey; cyclic for angles/hours; ColorBrewer at its exact class count; no rainbow for ordered values. Chart hierarchy: ≤4 hues, chrome at 20–30% contrast, highlight 100% vs others 35–45%, no gradients/shadows/perspective on data. Write a role→hex ledger before animating; accent on ≤2 marks; never let red/green or blue/purple alone carry a distinction.

name_en: Thermal 7-stop heat ramp
what: تدرج كاميرا حرارية (بارد، عميق، أخضر، أصفر، برتقالي، أحمر، أبيض) لحقول الحرارة وخرائط الشدة، مع سقف يمنعه من الاحتراق للأبيض. / A heat-camera ramp (cold, deep, green, yellow, orange, red, white) for heat fields and intensity maps, capped so it never blows to white.
how: Map heat 0–1 through seven stops blended with smoothstep at 0, .12, .30, .45, .60, .78, 1; cap heat at 0.75; background heat 0.34–0.66; keep dark→light so heat reads as brightness when you swap in a brand ramp. Full-screen fragment shader: fbm 5 octaves warp-the-warp, melt cycle 6 s, blob 0.37, flow 0.26, rim 0.6, halo 0.45; trail 24 points fading over 1.6 s.

name_en: Magma colormap and alpine terrain ramp
what: تدرج ماغما مضغوط (أسود → بنفسجي → أرجواني → مرجاني → برتقالي → ذهبي باهت) للطيف الصوتي، وتدرج جبلي يلون التضاريس بالارتفاع والميل. / A compact magma ramp (black→violet→magenta→coral→orange→pale gold) for spectrograms, and an alpine ramp that colours terrain by height and slope.

name_en: Harmony generator 2D/3D + harmony detector
what: يبني ألوانًا متكاملة أو متجاورة أو ثلاثية أو منقسمة أو رباعية من درجة أساس واحدة، كنصوص CSS أو ألوان three.js — ويصنّف لوحة موجودة. / Builds complementary/analogous/triadic/split/tetradic hues from one base as CSS strings or THREE.Color, and classifies an existing palette.
how: MOTION.palette(scheme, baseHue, {sat, light:[…]}) → {hues, css}; K3.harmony(scheme, hue, {sat .6, light .5}) → THREE.Color. Offsets: complementary 0/180, analogous −30/0/30, triadic 0/120/240, split 0/150/210, tetradic 0/60/180/240; defaults S 60% L 50%. blue_hour uses harmony('complementary', 222) → [222, 42] (blue sky vs orange lamps). Keep one family dominant, the complement only as accent. Detector: take chromatic colours (OKLCH C ≥ 0.04), test mono (±15°), analogous (±30°), complementary, split (±150°), triadic (±120°), square — tolerance ±15°; free combinations allowed but flagged. Ran here in Chromium (vendored kit/gsap.min.js + motion-kit.js): MOTION.palette('split', 210) → hues [210, 0, 60] as hsl(… 60% 50%), ('complementary', 222) → [222, 42].

name_ar: تدرجات إدراكية OKLCH وظلال بإزاحة الصبغة
name_en: Perceptual OKLCH ramps and hue-shifted shading
what: ابنِ السلالم في OKLCH حتى تبدو الخطوات متساوية فعلًا، وحرّك الصبغة: الظلال تبرد والإضاءات تدفأ بدل التغميق فقط؛ ولا أبيض نقي ولا رمادي محايد في لوحة فنية. / Build ramps in OKLCH so steps look even, and shift hue — shadows cooler, highlights warmer — instead of just darkening; no pure white or neutral grey in a painterly palette.
how: sRGB → linear → OKLab → OKLCH (Ottosson 2020); keep H within ±10° per family, vary L and C; Chromium renders oklch() natively in HTML/Remotion. Neutral ramp check: OKLCH L per stop, deltas d, uniformity = 1 − (max|d| − min|d|)/mean|d| ≥ 0.7. Material ramps 3–5 steps rotating hue 10–20° and raising saturation in darks. Painting family: deep blues, pale yellows, a green touch, warm ochre.

name_en: WCAG contrast math, role tiers and alpha flattening
what: احسب الإضاءة النسبية ونسبة التباين لكل نص فوق خلفيته قبل الرندر، بعتبة حسب دور النص، وادمج الشفافية أولًا لأن اللوحة الزجاجية فوق الفيديو تتغير. / Compute relative luminance and contrast for every caption/background pair before render, with thresholds by role, flattening alpha first because a glass plate over video changes.
how: Decode sRGB (c/12.92 if c ≤ 0.04045 else ((c+0.055)/1.055)^2.4), L = 0.2126R + 0.7152G + 0.0722B, ratio = (Lmax+0.05)/(Lmin+0.05). Body 4.5:1 (AAA 7:1); large text/UI/brand/links 3:1; disabled/hover optional — only body failures block delivery. Translucent plates: out = fg·α + bg·(1−α) per channel, sampling the darkest and brightest frames under the plate. Accessibility cut: AAA pairs, solid borders, no text over gradients (@media (prefers-contrast: more)). design_tokens.py implements this and ran here (22 pairs pass). (code snippet in references/powers/color-palette-grading.md)

name_en: Dark variant without inversion
what: لا تقلب الألوان: خلفية قريبة من الأسود بصبغة الهوية، نص أوف وايت، وألوان الهوية أقل تشبعًا وأفتح قليلًا — وتجنب الأسود والأبيض النقيين. / Don't invert: a brand-tinted near-black ground, off-white text, brand colours desaturated and lifted — and avoid pure #000/#fff.
how: bg hsl(220 10% 8%), text ~hsl(0 0% 90%); brand hsl(220 90% 50%) → hsl(220 70% 60%) (sat −20 pts, L +10 pts); darkest ~#111827 to avoid halation; use #0a0a0a and #fafaf9 instead of black/white; text tiers by opacity 100/60/40%, borders 10%. Re-run contrast in both modes.

name_en: One accent, one meaning (~5% of the frame)
what: لون تمييز واحد بمعنى واحد يغطي نحو 5% من البكسلات، ولحظة واحدة يملأ فيها الإطار؛ الوصول يُصبغ ثم يرتاح إلى المحايد؛ والمحايدات تميل لصبغة الهوية لا للرمادي. / One accent with one meaning on ~5% of pixels and one full-bleed beat; arrivals tint then relax to neutral; neutrals lean toward the brand hue instead of pure grey.
how: Lock roles before animating: one primary, a ~9-stop neutral ramp, success/warning/destructive as a separate axis (≈5 roles). Sequences ~80% neutral / ~20% accent; accent marks exactly one element per composition and never a placeholder (stand-in cards, avatars and series are alpha steps of the ink). Arrival tints relax to neutral over 12–50 frames. premium_edit takes --ivory/--ink/--accent/--accent2 (#F5F0E6 / #121417 / #E7B65A / #F3D9A4). Seen as ink black #090909, bone #f4f1ea and one signal orange #f27525 used only for the active element; light canvas with one #ff4c2d for selection, cursor and impact numbers.
params: accent ≈5% pixels; 80/20; tint relax 12–50 f; 5 roles

name_en: Strict two- and three-colour systems
what: أنت أنتجت أفلامًا بلونين أو ثلاثة فقط حيث التباين نفسه يصنع الإيقاع: حبر وورق ولون إشارة، تُقلب الأدوار بين الفصول. / You have produced films with only two or three colours where contrast itself makes the rhythm: ink, paper and one signal colour, roles swapped between chapters.
how: Choose ink + paper + one signal; every element must use one of them (no tints except alpha of ink); flip ground per chapter or bar (COLOR-66/67); max 3 hues, white type on a saturated single ground for heroes; avoid multi-gradients, sparkles and purple 'AI' clichés. Build: CSS vars --ink/--paper/--signal, scenes swap which is ground. (full table in references/powers/color-palette-grading.md)

name_en: Style lock and reference style-DNA (+ exact hex after generation)
what: قفل أسلوب يُنسخ حرفيًا في كل لقطة (5 ألوان hex، إضاءة، عدسة، تلوين، حبيبات، حقبة، 3 كلمات مزاج)، ووضع S ينسخ لوك مرجع بعد فحص 5–8 لقطات فعلًا — والهوية الدقيقة تُطبق في طبقة الحركة لا تُترك لمولد الصور. / A style lock copied verbatim into every shot (5 hex, lighting, lens, grade, grain, era, 3 mood words); mode S copies a reference look only after inspecting 5–8 frames; exact brand hex is applied in the motion layer, not trusted to the generator.
how: Intake 4–6 named hex (one bg = lightest, one accent). kinetic-flow theme S → REFERENCE stage demands DNA (palette hex, typography, objects, transitions, timing) → SCRIPT, label 'Reference: <name>'; never copy words, logos or people. Generators: 3–10 style references, then grade or overlay the true hex (e.g. a #8B2635 band) in HTML/SVG/Remotion — seeds do not transfer across models. production-profiles.test.mjs ran here (10/10).

name_en: Tone-mapping choice: ACES, AgX or Neutral
what: اختيار منحنى تحويل النغمات لكل لقطة: ACES قوي، AgX يحفظ صبغة الإضاءات الساطعة (نيون ونار)، وNeutral أمين لألوان المنتجات. / Pick the tone curve per shot: ACES punchy, AgX keeps hue in bright highlights (neon, fire), PBR Neutral faithful for products.
how: K3.makeRenderer(canvas, W, H, {tone:'aces'|'agx'|'neutral', exposure}) — pixelRatio 1, PCFShadowMap, preserveDrawingBuffer. Shipped exposures: blue_hour agx 1.05, night_boat agx .95, bunny neutral .9, lab neutral 1.0, koi .62, sound_ground .7; omni cinematic template uses ACESFilmic exposure 1.25 with FogExp2(#030712, .035). Runs in Chromium with no npm install through the pre-built `kit/three-kit.bundle.js` (904 KB IIFE with three.js inside); the ES-module `three-kit.js` needs `three` resolvable.
params: exposure .5–1.25; agx for lamps/neon, neutral for products

name_en: Look pass: gamut mask, Purkinje night vision, split toning
what: تمريرة بعد الرندر: قناع طيف يخفض تشبع الألوان خارج إسفين مختار فتتماسك اللوحة، ورؤية ليلية تُزرّق الظلال وتغرق الأحمر أولًا، وتقسيم لوني دافئ/بارد. / A post pass: a gamut mask that desaturates hues outside a chosen wedge, Purkinje night vision that turns darks rod-blue and sinks reds first, and warm-light / cool-shadow split toning.
how: const look = K3.makeLookPass({warm, cool}); composer.addPass(look); look.userData.set({gamut:[centreHueDeg, widthDeg, strength], night:0..1, split:0..1}) before OutputPass. Gamut edge feather 25° beyond half-width; night rod weights (.05,.55,.40), tint (.72,.86,1.12) on luma .02–.35, darken 25%; split warm #ffc98a / cool #5a7fb8, luma ramp .1–.7, strength ×0.35. Shipped: blue_hour {night .55, split .45, warm #ffb36a, cool #4a6aa8}; night_boat {night .35, split .55, warm #ffa860, cool #4f6fa8}. Runs in Chromium with no npm install through the pre-built `kit/three-kit.bundle.js` (904 KB IIFE with three.js inside); the ES-module `three-kit.js` needs `three` resolvable.

name_en: Aerial perspective: 3-channel fog, fog toward the sun, sky bounce
what: ضباب بثلاث قنوات (الأزرق يتشتت أكثر) فيصبح البعيد أزرق وأقل تباينًا؛ والضباب يدفأ حين تنظر نحو شمس منخفضة ويبقى باردًا بعيدًا عنها — قواعد غورني في الكود. / Per-channel fog (blue scatters most) so distance turns bluer and flatter; haze warms toward a low sun and stays cool away from it — Gurney's rules in code.
how: K3.aerialPerspective({scatter:[0.62, 0.85, 1.25]}) before the first render (patches the fog chunk), scene.fog colour = horizon sky (FogExp2). Per frame K3.fogTowardSun(scene, camera, sunDir, cool, warm, amount) with weight = max(0, dot(view, sun))³ × amount; skyBounce({sky, ground}) cool from above, warm from below. blue_hour: four identical dark ridges 0x2b2420 at 0.7/1.4/2.6/4.5 km, FogExp2(0x8790b0, 0.00062), cool 0x8790b0, warm 0xc49a8a, amount .9, scatter [.55,.8,1.3]. Seen: exponential fog tinted to sky #90b5ca. Runs in Chromium with no npm install through the pre-built `kit/three-kit.bundle.js` (904 KB IIFE with three.js inside); the ES-module `three-kit.js` needs `three` resolvable.

name_en: Shader grade pass driven by story or music
what: تلوين نهائي على مستوى الشيدر: ظلال باردة وإضاءات دافئة، دفء، رفع للسواد، انحراف لوني عند الحواف، فينيت وحبيبات — والمفاتيح تتغير كل إطار مع القصة أو الموسيقى. / A shader finish: cool shadows / warm highlights, warmth, black lift, edge chromatic aberration, vignette and grain — uniforms change per frame with story or music.
how: post.grade.uniforms uWarm / uLift / uVig / uCA: shadows (0.92,0.98,1.08), highlights (1.08,1.0,0.92), warm tint (1.05,.98,.9) × uWarm .5, vignette .42 smoothstep .35–.95, CA 1.2 px at 1920 scaled by radius. Shipped: koi warm .55 lift .02; sound_ground lift .08 ('no pure black') and warm .45 + .3·bass; water_cycle warm .75→.2 over 5 s, lift .08·overcast. Egypt-2120 pass after OutputPass: CA dot(d,d)·.006, saturation mix 1.08, oval vignette .38 smoothstep(.25,.85,|d·(1.1,.82)|), grain (hash−.5)·.028 stepped at 1/30 s. Runs in Chromium with no npm install through the pre-built `kit/three-kit.bundle.js` (904 KB IIFE with three.js inside); the ES-module `three-kit.js` needs `three` resolvable.

name_en: Named practical light colours (sodium, mercury, moon, flame)
what: ألوان مسماة لمصادر حقيقية — صوديوم، زئبق، قمر، لهب — وحرارات متباينة (قمر 4100K مقابل فانوس 1900K) تجعل الليل مقنعًا. / Named real-source colours — sodium, mercury, moon, flame — and contrasting temperatures (4100 K moon vs 1900 K lantern) that make night believable.
how: K3.lightColor('sodium'|'mercury'|'moon'|'flame') from LIGHT_SOURCES. night_boat: sky zenith (0.004,0.008,0.024), horizon (0.035,0.058,0.105), fog #0d1626, sea #061525, lantern #ff9a3c, title #f3ead8, rule #e0a35a — one ember source against navy and silver. Plan the gel with COLOR-23. Runs in Chromium with no npm install through the pre-built `kit/three-kit.bundle.js` (904 KB IIFE with three.js inside); the ES-module `three-kit.js` needs `three` resolvable.

name_en: Painter filmic curve, split-tone grade and grain
what: في مشاهد الرسم بالكود: منحنى ACES فيلمي بتعريض وتباين وتشبع ورفع، وتلوين يرفع الظلال نحو لون والإضاءات نحو آخر، وحبيبات مبذورة. / For code-painted scenes: an ACES-fitted filmic curve with exposure/contrast/saturation/lift, a shadows→colour / highlights→colour grade, and seeded grain.
how: filmic(exposure, contrast, saturation, lift) with y = x(2.51x+.03)/(x(2.43x+.59)+.14) — scenes that use it set ROLLOFF = 1.0; grade(shadows, highlights, amount, contrast); grain(amount, seed). Shipped: whale (1.0, 1.14, 1.04); dragon night grade #0b0820 / #ffe9cf .45 c1.06; duck storm #0a1426 / #ffe2c4 .4 c1.08. Ran here via render.py on a gradient plate: mean abs change filmic 26.7, grade 2.1, grain 4.1 (the module imports without OpenCV; its unittest file needs OpenCV).

name_en: Highlight roll-off quantiser
what: يحوّل اللوحة العائمة إلى 8 بت بكتف tanh فوق نقطة ركبة، فتبقى النار والتوهج غنية بدل القص — وركبة 1.0 تحفظ ألوان الشعار بدقة. / Converts the float canvas to 8-bit with a tanh shoulder above a knee so fire and glows stay rich instead of clipping; knee 1.0 keeps logo colours exact.
how: to_uint8(rolloff=k): x > k → k + (1−k)·tanh((x−k)/(1−k)); default 0.82, filmic scenes 1.0. Ran here: a pure white fill renders (244,244,244) at the default knee and (255,255,255) at 1.0. (code snippet in references/powers/color-palette-grading.md)

name_en: Vignette in every engine
what: تعتيم الأطراف لتركيز العين في المركز — بنفس الروح في Canvas وthree.js وFFmpeg وCSS ومشاهد الرسام. / Edge darkening that focuses the centre — the same intent in Canvas, three.js, FFmpeg, CSS and painter scenes.
how: 2D motion-kit: MOTION.vignette(stage, {inner:55%, strength:.42, z:89}) = transparent to 55% → rgba(0,0,0,.42). Painter: vignette(strength) smoothstep from 35% of the half-diagonal, typical .45–.6 (ran here). TSL/WebGPU: v = clamp(1 − dist·1.5, 0, 1); color.rgb *= v. FFmpeg: vignette=PI/5 (Basma uses it when strength > 0.3; I used PI/4.5 in tests). CSS: radial-gradient overlay. Photo stacks 10–15% (COLOR-82).
params: inner 55% / .42; painter .45–.6; TSL falloff 1.5; ffmpeg PI/5

name_en: Gradient paints with alpha stops and blend modes
what: تعبئة أي شكل أو نص بتدرج خطي أو شعاعي بمحطات تحمل شفافية (#rrggbbaa)، مع تنعيم ودمج normal/add/screen/multiply. / Fill any shape or text with linear/radial gradients whose stops carry alpha (#rrggbbaa), softened by blur, with normal/add/screen/multiply blending.
how: lin((x1,y1),(x2,y2),[(0,c0),…,(1,cn)]) / rad((cx,cy), r, stops), evaluated per pixel by Ctx.paint; fill(shape, paint, alpha, blur, mode). Ran here with a #0b1020→#ffb86b plate.

name_en: Polarity flip ink↔paper at act boundaries
what: المسرح يبدّل الخلفية والمقدمة (حبر↔ورق) عند حدود الفصل راكبًا القطع — من الفوضى المظلمة إلى الحل المضيء، أو من الفاتح إلى «الصورة الأكبر». / The stage swaps background and foreground (ink↔paper) at an act boundary, riding a cut — dark chaos to airy solution, or light to the 'bigger picture'.
how: MOTION.polarity(tl, stage, at, bg, fg) = one tl.to on backgroundColor + color, 0.1 s (6 f) E.smooth, only at act boundaries, never on a static frame. Ran here in Chromium with the vendored gsap: at t=0.9 s bg rgb(11,13,18), at 1.05 s mid-grey rgb(128,127,126), at 1.2 s rgb(244,241,234) with ink inverted. Observed variants: instant 0-frame switch on a drop with the hero held in place; e-ink style 2–4-frame invert flash then swap (<150 ms); #fafcf9→#0e271e over ~500 ms keeping white cards; charcoal #201f1a→cream #f6efe7 over ~300 ms at ~⅓ of the film; same hue family 90%→25% lightness for act 2.
license: motion-kit runs on GSAP — GSAP 'Standard no-charge' license (gsap.com/standard-license), not MIT.

name_en: Colour-field chapter and beat flips
what: كل فصل أو ضربة يملك خلفية مسطحة مشبعة من 3–4 ألوان للهوية، والقطع نفسه يصبح تغيير لون، ولون النص ينقلب ليبقى مقروءًا. / Each chapter or beat owns one flat saturated ground from a 3–4-colour brand set; every cut is also a colour change and text inverts to stay legible.
how: Keep ink colours constant, rotate grounds; flood the next colour across the frame (~400 ms) or hard-cut on the beat (≤1 flip per bar, never tweened when the brief says instant). Owner base: MOTION.polarity for two colours; HyperFrames palette-flip primitive re-skins via 0 ms variable flips anchored to section changes (needs gsap on the page — vendored as kit/gsap.min.js). (code snippet in references/powers/color-palette-grading.md) (full table in references/powers/color-palette-grading.md)
params: 3–4 grounds; flood ~400 ms or 0 ms on beat; ≤1 flip/bar

name_en: Full-bleed accent beat / brand flash fill
what: لحظة واحدة يمتلئ فيها الإطار كله بلون الهوية أو لون صادم — للنكتة أو الوعد أو الشعار — ثم يعود المسرح. / One moment where the whole frame floods with the brand or a shock colour — for the punchline, promise or logo — then the stage returns.
how: Tween the stage background to the brand for ~0.8 s while the hero shrinks to a tile (#1ed760 → darker #18a04a), or hard-cut to a flat accent frame with tone-on-tone serif text 15% darker and hold ~0.7 s, then collapse to a centre dash; or switch to lime for one scene with a hard cut or 200 ms fade, then back to cream; or one white punchline card in a dark film, cut in/out on the beat (~1 s). This is the one full-bleed beat COLOR-54 allows.

name_en: Sky-stop tweening: time of day and seasons
what: لوحة الفيلم كلها تنجرف بتحريك محطات تدرج السماء: ليل → فجر → صباح، أو غروب → شفق → ليل في لقطة واحدة، أو دورة الفصول — مع إضاءة المصابيح حين يعتم. / The whole film palette drifts by tweening sky-gradient stops: night→dawn→morning, sunset→dusk→night in one take, or a season cycle — lamps switch on as it darkens.
how: GSAP on SVG stop-color: tl.to('#s0', {attr:{'stop-color':…}, duration:11, ease:'sine.inOut'}, 0) then a 13.7 s second leg; silhouette fill #1d0f2c→#3a1d3c; veil opacity .38→.22 linear; stars fade out from 2 s over 9 s. Thursday-dua stops: night #0b1033/#3b1f5e/#b9507a → dawn #2b3d86/#c4677a/#ffb066 → morning #34509a/#f2a079/#ffd890. Observed: sunset #f0bd9f/#e58c8c → dusk #9f6986 → night #292142 over ~25 s; day→night with a cool grey multiply 0→35% #6a6f86 and a 300 px lamp glow; 3D: sun elevation + exposure −2 EV over 4–6 s, fog to teal-black; season parameter 0..4 (~7 s each, 1–2 s crossfades) swapping tree fill and particle emitter. gsap is vendored as kit/gsap.min.js. (code snippet in references/powers/color-palette-grading.md)
params: legs 11 s + 13.7 s; ~25 s single take; seasons 7 s

name_en: Grade change as story (drain, bloom, freeze to grey)
what: اللون يحكي المغزى: صورة المال تنطفئ للرمادي بصبغة حمراء عند «غير سعيد»، وصورة الفرح تومض ثم تستقر دافئة مشبعة، واللحظة تزداد غنى — أو يتجمد اللون للرمادي لمدة مقطع موسيقي ثم يعود. / Colour carries the moral: the money plate drains to grey with a red cast on 'unhappy', the joy plate flashes over-bright and settles warm and saturated, the moment keeps getting richer — or colour freezes to grey for one bar and snaps back.
how: GSAP on img CSS filter: drain grayscale(.9) brightness(.7) contrast(1.15) in 0.6 s + tint rgba(80,0,0,.22); joy brightness(1.6) saturate(.6) → brightness(1) saturate(1.15) in 0.9 s; moment saturate(.9) → saturate(1.25) brightness(1.05) over 8 s; tints rgba(10,30,45,.25), rgba(20,60,110,.18), rgba(255,170,60,.08). Freeze: saturate(0) + a slight contrast drop switched in 1 frame, held one bar, snapped back on the downbeat.
params: drain .6 s; bloom .9 s; enrich 8 s; freeze = 1 bar
license: GSAP 'Standard no-charge' license when timed with GSAP.

name_en: Narrative colour logic (problem → solution)
what: لون واحد لكل فصل سردي: أحمر متوهج لنقاط الألم وسماوي للعرض، وبطاقة يقلب توهجها ونصها من الأحمر للسماوي لتظهر المشكلة وهي تُحل؛ ولكل مرحلة حياة أرضيتها. / One accent per narrative act: red glow for pain points, cyan for the offer, a card whose glow and text flip red→cyan as the problem is solved; each life stage owns its ground.
how: Ground #0a1822→#10374b radial, red #e8333f for the problem (glow + second headline line), cyan #1fb3e6 for the offer, green #2ee6a0 for proof; flip a card's glow + text over ~300 ms at the turn. Red reserved for mistakes, green for fixes (#c9463d / #1f7a4f on cream #eee8dc). Navy base, white type, orange ≤15% of the frame; red/green only in charts.

name_en: Per-item hue coding at equal luminance
what: كل عنصر أو صوت أو فئة يحصل على صبغة واحدة تتكرر في شارته ونقطته وإطاره وتوهجه، بإضاءة متقاربة على خلفية ثابتة — والعين تتبع العنصر بلونه. / Each item, voice or class gets one hue reused on its pill, bullet, brackets and glow, at similar luminance on a constant ground — the eye tracks it by colour.
how: Hues at ~70% saturation and similar lightness (check with COLOR-46/52); keep the base constant (navy); reuse the same colours in the recap list. Observed sets: items orange/blue/purple/amber/green/pink; instruments cyan glock, amber marimba, violet bass, red drums, yellow cymbals on navy; skills lime #c6f432 primary + #7b4fe8 / #ff2e88 / #3fd0e6 on #0a0815; multi-ink black #1c1c1c structure, red #c42d3f errors, blue #2b4a9b definitions, green #2f8a5b conclusions; hot #e8665a / cold #3ec7c0; one solid colour column per faction; sentiment classes teal/pink/yellow crossfaded.

name_en: Full-frame event tint and flash
what: يُصبغ الإطار كله بلون الحدث طوال مدته (تعويذة زرقاء، قرمزية، حمراء) ويقوى للحظة الاصطدام؛ وحالة الخطأ تصبغ حتى 15% عنبري. / Multiply/overlay the whole frame with the event colour for its duration (blue, crimson, red spell), flashing stronger on impact; an error state tints up to 15% amber.
how: Overlay div or Canvas fillRect with mix-blend-mode multiply/overlay at 30–60% for the cast, 2–3 frames stronger on impact, then release; for UI errors cap at 15%. Keep text contrast checked (COLOR-52).

name_en: Hue-indexed rings and slow hue rotation
what: صبغة كل حلقة تُشتق من ترتيبها (وردي في الداخل حتى فيروزي في الخارج)، والعداد يأخذ لون الحلقة الداخلية؛ أو خلفية تدور صبغتها 360° كل 10 ثوانٍ بدل القطع. / Each ring's hue comes from its index (pink inside to teal outside) and the counter takes the innermost hue; or a background that rotates 360° per 10 s instead of cutting.
how: hue = 330° → 185° across ring index, HSL L ~65% S ~80% on near-black; or step 30° per ring around the wheel. Rotation: CSS filter hue-rotate or a shader uniform 360°/10 s while keeping text ≥4.5:1 (check at the worst hue).

name_en: Two-tone headline and accent word
what: أول العبارة بلون والنكتة بلون الهوية، أو كلمة واحدة لكل ضربة تأخذ تعبئة ليمونية وخطًا سميكًا تحتها — واللون نفسه لكل الأزرار التفاعلية. / First phrase in one colour, punchline in the brand colour, or one word per beat gets a lime fill and thick underline — the same colour reused on interactive pills.
how: Cream #f3f0e4 + lime #d8f24a on navy #07131f; black heavy grotesk #111 with the last 1–2 words in brand orange #ef5a0c and an orange dot bullet on the kicker; strict black/white + lime #c5fc34 for the beat word, magenta #ff2bd6 only for bars and bullets. For Arabic apply the colour to whole words (see ARAB powers).
params: 1 accent word per beat; underline thick

name_en: Swatch-strip reveal
what: صف من ستة مربعات ألوان بأسماء hex تحتها يظهر من اليسار لليمين كدليل «كتاب الأسلوب». / A row of six colour squares with hex labels pops in left to right as a 'style book' proof.
how: 40 px squares, mono hex labels 8 px under each, stagger 50 ms, scale 0→1 with a small overshoot; feed it the palette from COLOR-24 or COLOR-31 (RTL layouts reverse the order).

name_en: Indexed 16-colour palette with alternating accent flash
what: فكرة: سقف 16 لونًا للفيلم كله، ولونا تمييز يتبادلان على الإطارات الفردية والزوجية لثلاثة إطارات عند كل تعويذة، وومضة أخيرة بأربعة ألوان. / Idea: cap the whole film at 16 colours; two accents alternate on odd/even frames for 3 frames per spell, and a final 4-colour flash.
how: Untested: keep an indexed palette array, quantise every frame to it (Pillow quantize with a fixed palette or HyperFrames ordered dither), swap the two accent indices on frame parity for 3 frames.

name_en: Radial dark grounds
what: خلفية داكنة بمركز أفتح قليلًا — كحلي تقني، جمر دافئ، توهج أحمر، HUD دافئ — وهي بداية القالب المختبر. / A dark ground with a slightly lighter centre — tech navy, ember, red glow, warm HUD — and the tested starter's default.
how: Canvas starter: radial-gradient(#182446 → #0b1020 55%) + 90 px grid at .045 (tested). Fastify: createLinearGradient(0,0,w,h) stop0 #0c1728 on even scenes / #132337 on odd → #090d1d, so consecutive scenes breathe. 3D: K3S.studioBackdrop({inner #1e4a44, mid #0c2224 at 55%, outer #050c0d, cy .42}) as scene.background (512 px canvas). Observed: navy #131e35 → #0a121f; ember: black + off-centre #43211a at 40%; warm HUD #3a1a0e → #0e0e0b + 40 px grid at 4% + vignette; dark + radial red 15%; navy + gold accent.
params: centre→edge 55%; grid 90 px @ .045; alt start per scene

name_en: Warm paper editorial ground
what: ورق كريمي دافئ بحبر شبه أسود ولون واحد للفعل، مع فينيت شعاعي خفيف — للفصول الهادئة والخاتمات العاطفية والشرح التحريري. / Warm cream paper with near-black ink and one action colour, under a faint radial vignette — for calm chapters, emotional outros and editorial explainers.
how: Base #f4eee0 / ink #1f1b17 / highlight #f6cf9a / action #d9472b; radial #fcf7ed → #f2ebe1 with rust #c0502e; #efefe5 with an 8% vignette behind dark UI cards; #e6e1d2 with a 35% edge vignette and coral accent words in italic serif; split variant: two close grounds #f6f2e9 / #ebdcc7 with a soft shadow seam, coffee ink #3e2a20, terracotta #b0643a. Owner equivalents: ledger #fbf8f3 (COLOR-32), viral-editorial palettes 1/3 (COLOR-39).

name_en: Drifting blob / mesh-gradient ambient ground
what: 3–4 بقع لونية ضخمة شديدة الضبابية تنجرف ببطء على أساس فاتح أو داكن — شفق بنفسجي برتقالي أسفل الإطار، أو باستيل خوخي ولافندر، أو تدرج خطي باستيل مع شبكة نقاط. / 3–4 huge, heavily blurred colour blobs drifting slowly over a light or dark base — violet/orange aurora along the bottom, peach/lavender pastels, or a pastel linear gradient with a dot grid.
how: Pure CSS (works now): absolutely positioned divs with radial-gradient(closest-side, colour, transparent), size 60–80% of width, opacity .15–.9, blur 120–300 px, sine drift period 8–12 s (10–40 px per 10 s); warm one blob up on a key event. Pastel linear: linear-gradient(180deg, #c4a4ed, #f3daed) with #1c1838 text (>7:1), or 30° peach #f6eada → lavender #dfe4f2 with 1 px dots every 24 px at 8%. Shader: noise(uv·k + t·0.05) mixing #00F0FF / #7000FF / #000000. HyperFrames ready blocks: mesh-gradient-bg, mk-background (10 s, 1920×1080, GSAP). (code snippet in references/powers/color-palette-grading.md)
params: blur 120–300 px; period 8–12 s; dots 1 px / 24 px @ 8%
install: npm i -D hyperframes@0.8.164 && npx hyperframes add mesh-gradient-bg
license: the HyperFrames blocks are timed with GSAP — GSAP 'Standard no-charge' license; the pure-CSS recipe needs no licence.

name_en: WebGPU shader colour plates
what: سبع خلفيات شيدر جاهزة مدة كل منها ثانيتان: بقعة مرجانية، عجلة ألوان، تدرج متدفق، خريطة حرارية، تدرج شبكي، بلازما، دوامة. / Seven ready 2 s shader plates: coral Blob, ColorWheel, FlowingGradient, Heatmap orb, MeshGradient, Plasma, Swirl.
how: `npx hyperframes add blob|color-wheel|flowing-gradient|heatmap|mesh-gradient|plasma|swirl`, or place lib/shaders.iife.js (1,444,793 bytes, shaders 4.0.0) beside the HTML and declare <canvas data-shader="Plasma" width=1920 height=1080> in a root marked data-requires-webgpu data-no-timeline. Rendering needs a WebGPU-capable Chromium — headless WebGPU is not verified here; fall back to COLOR-80's CSS blobs if it fails.
install: npm i -D hyperframes@0.8.164 && npx hyperframes add plasma

name_en: Unify the stack: one grade, grain, vignette
what: تلوين واحد فوق التركيب كله، وحبيبات 2–4%، وفينيت 10–15%، وظل تلامس لكل قصاصة — حتى تُقرأ الطبقات كصورة واحدة. / One grade over the whole composition, 2–4% grain, a 10–15% vignette and a contact shadow for every cut-out, so layers read as one photograph.
how: Grade the final composite, not each layer (a per-layer warm over-sharpened HDR grade never fuses); grain 2–4%; vignette 10–15%; contact shadow blur 24 px, offset 0, opacity .35. Check question before render: is one grade plus grain applied to the whole stack?

name_en: Treatment ladder: colour → duotone → halftone → vector
what: الصورة تنزل درجات الأسلوب على الإيقاع أو الكلمات: لون كامل، ثنائي اللون، هافتون، ثم فيكتور مسطح — ونسخ بوب آرت ثنائية اللون بتوقيت متتابع. / A photo steps down stylisations on beats or words: full colour, duotone, halftone, flat vector — plus pop-art duotone clones with offset timing.
how: duotone 300 ms → halftone 300 ms → flat vector 400 ms, each on a beat or word boundary; luma threshold 0.5; dot pitch 8–12 px at 1080 width. Duotone = map luma between two hex (CSS: grayscale + two blended layers; FFmpeg: format=gray then lut/colorize; HyperFrames two-ink-print). Tiles: one duotone shader per tile with staggered starts.

name_en: Vintage collage finish with exposure flicker
what: عوالم كولاج فوتوغرافي بتلوين عتيق باهت: نزع 40% من التشبع، صبغة سيبيا، فينيت داكن، حبيبات متحركة، ووميض تعريض خفيف. / Photo-collage worlds under a muted vintage grade: ~40% desaturation, sepia tint, dark vignette, animated grain and a slight exposure flicker.
how: Observed numbers: vignette 0.6, grain 8%, flicker ±3% luminance; palette #221d17 / #332b22 / #6b746d / #a09b89 / #c4c2b3 / #928573. FFmpeg recipe (this exact chain ran here; YAVG swung 89.3–99.3 across 30 frames): hue=s=0.6 → a 50% sepia colorchannelmixer → eq brightness 0.03·sin(2π·6t) with eval=frame → vignette → noise alls=8 allf=t+u. (code snippet in references/powers/color-palette-grading.md)
params: desat 40%; vignette .6; grain 8%; flicker ±3% at ~6 Hz

name_en: Sunset/synthwave, psychedelic and monohue-push palettes
what: سماء خوخية وردية نيلية مع ظلال بنفسجية وإضاءات برتقالية، وشمس عملاقة مخططة، ولوحة سايكدلك نيلية برتقالية وردية ليمونية، ودفع كل الصور نحو بنفسجي واحد بسواد مسحوق. / Peach→pink→indigo skies with purple shadows and orange highlights, a giant striped sun, an indigo/orange/pink/lemon psychedelic palette, and pushing all imagery toward one violet with crushed blacks.
how: Sunset: sky #f5c798 → #e5a880 → #9a6766 → #170926, lift shadows to purple, highlights to orange, slight vignette. Synthwave sun: radial red gradient disc with horizontal dark bands in its bottom third. Monohue push: base #0c0b10, accent #9a6cf0, crush blacks, lift highlights, grain 4% + vignette for cohesion (FFmpeg: hue=s=0.4 then colorbalance toward violet, or a Reinhard transfer to a violet reference, COLOR-26).

name_en: White clay render with colour only for data
what: مشهد ثلاثي الأبعاد كله رمادي فاتح كالطين، بإضاءة نصف كروية وضباب أبيض، واللون محجوز فقط لتدفق البيانات. / A 3D scene entirely in light-grey clay under hemisphere light and white fog, with colour reserved only for data flows.
how: MeshStandardMaterial light grey (roughness high), HemisphereLight, white FogExp2; tone mapping neutral (COLOR-57); the only saturated colour is the moving data (one hue per flow, COLOR-72).
params: 1 data hue per flow; everything else grey

name_en: Measured style pack and grading by measurement
what: البرومبت لا يصنع تدريجًا لونيًا؛ القياس يصنعه: قِس الكروما لكل منطقة إضاءة والوسيط والتباين ونسبة الخلفية الداكنة، ثم طبّق الفرق. — A prompt cannot deliver a grade; measurement can: measure chroma per lightness zone, medians, contrast and dark-background share, then apply the difference.
when: مطابقة مظهر فيديو مرجعي أو تثبيت لون سلسلة لقطات مولدة — matching a reference look or locking colour across generated shots.
how: Measure in CIELAB: chroma per L* zone with edges [0, 15, 35, 55, 75, 100] (print the whole curve); median + MAD, not mean + std (skew inflated a mean ~2×, 36.9 vs 17.5); contrast = std(L*); background share = pixels below L* 10 as its own statistic; mask UI chrome (letterbox, status bar, icons) first. Generate neutral ('Colour: none. Render neutral.') and grade afterwards: in the source, three paid generations moved midtone a* only +1.9…+0.3 against a +24.9 target, while one measured pass hit chroma MAE 1.88. Apply: direct measurement beat a baked LUT (MAE 1.58); anchor tone instead of CDF matching when histograms differ (background kept 69 % vs 26 %); grade in batches of 6 frames (48 ran out of memory); never ship on MAE alone, check the background share too. One pack per genre.
